_about: Crew environments used to rank investigations. Atmosphere figures come from the challenge statement unless marked as an assumption.

en.name: Space station
en.note: Sea-level pressure of 14.7 psi is quoted in the challenge; ~21% O2 is the Earth baseline.

ar.name: محطة فضائية
ar.note: ضغط سطح البحر 14.7 psi مذكور في التحدي، و21% أكسجين هو خط الأساس الأرضي.

scenarios.need: Fire safety on a crewed space station in microgravity with an Earth-like atmosphere of about 21 percent oxygen and low-speed ventilation: flammability and flame spread of cabin fabrics and plastics, smoke detection and fire suppression.

en.name: Transit spacecraft
en.note: Assumption: Earth-like cabin. The challenge gives no figures for transit vehicles.

ar.name: مركبة فضائية في رحلة
ar.note: افتراض: جو مقصورة مثل الأرض، لأن التحدي لا يعطي أرقاماً لمركبات العبور.

scenarios.need: Fire safety inside a small crewed spacecraft in microgravity far from Earth: how fast a large fire grows in a confined vehicle, material flammability limits compared with NASA ground screening tests, smoke detection and extinguishing a fire.

en.name: Lunar surface base
en.note: Challenge: the oxygen concentration on the Moon will likely be 30% or greater at 10.2 psi or less. PSI holds no partial-gravity data yet.

ar.name: قاعدة على سطح القمر
ar.note: من التحدي: الأكسجين في القاعدة القمرية سيكون غالباً 30% أو أكثر عند 10.2 psi أو أقل. لا توجد في PSI بيانات جاذبية جزئية بعد.

scenarios.need: Fire safety in a Moon base with an oxygen-enriched, reduced-pressure atmosphere of 30 percent oxygen or more at 10.2 psi or less, in partial lunar gravity: material flammability at elevated oxygen and reduced pressure, partial-gravity flames, detection and suppression.

en.name: Pressurized rover
en.note: Challenge: Moon bases and rovers sit between spacesuit (100% O2 at 4.3 psi) and Earth (14.7 psi) conditions.

ar.name: مركبة جوّالة مضغوطة
ar.note: من التحدي: القاعدة والجوّالات بين ظروف بدلة الفضاء (100% أكسجين عند 4.3 psi) والأرض (14.7 psi).

scenarios.need: Fire safety in a small pressurized rover cabin with an oxygen-enriched reduced-pressure atmosphere of 30 percent oxygen or more: ignition and flame spread over materials at high oxygen, fire growth in a small confined volume, fast detection and suppression.

en.name: Mars surface base
en.note: Assumption: same atmosphere as the Moon base. The challenge says microgravity and normal-gravity results could bound intermediate gravity.

ar.name: قاعدة على سطح المريخ
ar.note: افتراض: نفس جو القاعدة القمرية. التحدي يقول إن نتائج الجاذبية الصغرى والأرضية قد تحدّ الجاذبية المتوسطة.

scenarios.need: Fire safety in a long-duration Mars habitat in partial gravity with an oxygen-enriched exploration atmosphere and no resupply: material flammability at elevated oxygen, partial-gravity flames bounded by microgravity and normal-gravity results, predictive fire models, detection and suppression.
